# codeSpark

> codeSpark is the #1 learn-to-code app for kids ages 3-10, using game-based learning and drag-and-drop programming to teach coding fundamentals.

codeSpark, created by Begin Learning, offers interactive coding education through engaging games like The Foos and Hour of Code curriculum. The platform serves both parents and educators with resources for K-5 students, emphasizing early childhood coding education and problem-solving skills.

## Key Topics

- Learn-to-code app
- Ages 3-10
- Drag-and-drop programming
